## Veterinary Internist

Internal Medicine Garden City, Idaho

### Description

WestVet, a MedVet Partner, is currently seeking a Veterinary Internist or residency-trained individual to join our Internal Medicine Team in our Boise, Idaho hospital. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and is dedicated to practicing quality medicine. The recruited candidate will join the MedVet/WestVet Team and treat over 100,000 patients annually.   

Why join the team at WestVet Boise?  

  * WestVet Boise was the first integrated emergency and veterinary specialty hospital in Idaho. 
  * We are AAHA accredited and are a VECCS Level II Emergency Facility.
  * In addition to 24/7 emergency services, we offer Anesthesia & Analgesia, Cardiology, Critical Care, Dentistry & Oral Surgery, Internal Medicine, Medical Oncology, Ophthalmology, Radiology, and Surgery. We also have a veterinary social worker on our team.
  * Nearby WestVet Urgent Care helps alleviate wait times in our ER and provides a continuum of care for pets.

# Pet Cancer Treatment

Fighting cancer while keeping your pet comfortable.

Image: Pet receiving cancer treatment at a veterinary hospital

## Expert Cancer Treatment and Support

Like people, pets can develop cancer at any stage of life. Our clinic provides comprehensive oncology support designed to guide pets and their owners through diagnosis, treatment, and recovery. Some cancers can be treated effectively with surgery alone, while others may benefit from chemotherapy or a combination of therapies.

Although we are not board-certified oncologists, our team has extensive experience administering chemotherapy for lymphoma and select cancers. Not every cancer responds to chemotherapy, so we evaluate each case individually to determine the most effective treatment plan for your pet.

We proudly serve families seeking compassionate, supportive care for pets with cancer, helping pets maintain comfort and quality of life throughout treatment.

# Reed Linenberger, DVM

Image: Dr. Reed Linenberger smiling while wearing a checked shirt and standing outdoors.

Dr. Reed Linenberger is the managing veterinarian and co-founder of Habitat Veterinary Hospital, with nearly two decades of experience caring for pets across Idaho. Originally from Bainbridge Island, Washington, he earned his bachelor’s degree in Zoology from the University of Washington before receiving his Doctor of Veterinary Medicine from Ross University. He completed his clinical training at the University of Wisconsin–Madison School of Veterinary Medicine.

Reed and his wife, Dr. Sohaila Maleki, met during veterinary school and moved to Boise in 2004. Together, they opened Habitat Veterinary Hospital in 2007—a one-room wellness clinic that has since grown into a trusted leader in the Treasure Valley veterinary community. In 2023, Reed helped lead Habitat’s expansion to the Wood River Valley with the acquisition of St. Francis Pet Clinic in Ketchum, originally founded by Dr. Karsten Fostvedt.

Dr. Linenberger is passionate about internal medicine, soft tissue surgery, and oncology, and brings a holistic approach to care through his certification in veterinary acupuncture and Chinese medicine. He completed his acupuncture training through the International Veterinary Acupuncture Society (IVAS) in 2015 and enjoys integrating traditional and complementary therapies to support lifelong pet wellness.

Reed currently splits his time between Habitat’s Boise and Ketchum locations, helping guide both teams while continuing to serve the pets and people who’ve made Habitat what it is today. Outside the hospital, he enjoys spending time with his wife and their two children, skiing in the Wood River Valley, and exploring Idaho’s wild spaces.

Available

###### Chemotherapy & Radiation (Oncology)

Available

We provide chemotherapy and radiation therapy for pets diagnosed with cancer. Our oncology services include treatment protocols designed to target malignant cells while minimizing side effects and maintaining quality of life.

###### CT Scan & MRI (Advanced Imaging)

Available

We offer advanced imaging including CT scans and MRIs for pets requiring detailed diagnostic information. These sophisticated imaging techniques provide high-resolution views of internal structures to aid in accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.

###### Dialysis (Advanced Kidney Care)

Available

We provide dialysis for pets with advanced kidney disease to support renal function when the body can no longer adequately filter waste. This specialized therapy helps manage uremia and improve the quality of life for pets with chronic kidney failure.

###### Stem Cell Therapy (Regenerative Medicine)

Available

We offer stem cell therapy as a regenerative medicine approach to treat conditions such as osteoarthritis and inflammatory diseases in pets. This innovative treatment uses the body’s own cells to promote healing and reduce inflammation in affected joints and tissues.
